# Barlow

The online and options screens' fonts (PLAN-0.4 F1), embedded in the executable by
`app/src/renut_engine/gpu/overlay/overlay_ui.cpp`: Barlow Regular (text), Barlow SemiBold (stronger text) and Barlow
Condensed Bold (titles). They cover every character the screens use (Spanish and Portuguese accents, ¡ ¿ ±);
Segoe UI, where Windows has it, comes after them for the rest (a player's name in another alphabet).

- Source: [google/fonts](https://github.com/google/fonts) commit `5bb28733cec3`, `ofl/barlow` and
  `ofl/barlowcondensed`, unmodified; version 1.408.
- Author: Jeremy Tribby, The Barlow Project Authors ([jpt/barlow](https://github.com/jpt/barlow)).
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`LICENSE.txt`, shipped in the release's `licencias` folder).
